title: Crystal PVP Basics
description: This projects Makes most of the items in Crystal PVP much smaller and easier to see the screen by making items small.
body:
# Whats about this pack...
- This makes many minecraft items used in Crystal PVP Smalled.
- Specially Golden Apples, Enchnated Golden Apples much smaller.
- This has both low Fire and Short Swords (Blade Edition) Applied
- Thanks for Visiting the project
### Enjoy!
